sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Parity row 2.2 and gap 8 (docs/orchestrator-parity.md in the s165 worktree). The role matrix and the lineup it recommends belong to slicer (`docs/boundaries.md`, Ownership table; adj `lineup.source`). The matrix lives in `.slicer/relay-roles.json` and changes only through `slicer relay-roles add|set|remove|move|rule-edit` (also `rule-add`, `rule-remove`; `slicer relay-roles --help`). Each takes `--render`. No ork code calls them: ork runs only `relay-roles show --json` and `recommend` (`internal/slicercli/write.go:94-102`, `:193-205`). So to change a model, effort or row order the owner goes to the outer session. This slice is a v1.1 slice (owner decision 2026-10-29, orchestrator-parity.md, Owner decisions); it follows S168, the read-only matrix view.

Design (*proposed*): ork stays a front end for slicer's commands and never edits `.slicer` files. The editor works on the view S168 draws. Each edit shows the exact `slicer relay-roles ...` command and asks `[y/N]`; the daemon runs it in the project's main checkout through the write helper with no run record (the pattern of `internal/engine/speccheck.go:373`), with `--render`, and leaves the change uncommitted for the owner. Slicer's own validation errors are shown verbatim. A run already started keeps its lineup (`runrec.Record.Lineup`); an open launch plan that the edit changes is refused by the `plan changed` check at `run.start` (`internal/daemon/runs.go:489-495`). Rows whose agent ork has no adapter for are skipped when planning (`matrixAdapters`, `runs.go:321,395`); the editor warns when a row would be skipped.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- TestRelayRowSetPassesOnlyTheGivenFields (slicercli): `set r5 --model opus` builds `relay-roles set r5 --model opus --render --json --root R` and no other flag.
- TestRelayRowAddRemoveMoveRuleEditArgv (slicercli): the argv of `add`, `remove`, `move --before`/`--last` and `rule-edit`.
- TestMatrixEditRunsTheSlicerCommand (daemon): `matrix.edit` runs exactly one `relay-roles` write in the project path, with no run record and a `writes` log line.
- TestMatrixEditPassesSlicersRefusalThrough (daemon): a failing command returns slicer's code and text unchanged.
- TestMatrixEditRefusesAnUnregisteredProject (daemon): `not_found`, no call.
- TestMatrixEditorAsksWithTheExactCommand (tui): the prompt shows the full command and `[y/N] (Enter is No)`; `n`, Enter and `esc` make no call.
- TestMatrixEditorWarnsOnARowOrkCannotRun (tui): an agent other than `Claude Code` or `Codex` shows the skip warning.
- TestMatrixEditorShowsTheNewMatrixAfterAnEdit (tui): the view reloads and the status names the row.
- TestMatrixEditorGoldens (tui): golden of the edit form and prompt at 80x24, colour and monochrome.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
UI slice: UI pass (r14). After S168; reuse its row cursor and its `relay-roles show` read. Size L: if the spec grows, split into the wire (slicercli, daemon, a CLI form) and the TUI editor.
1. Tests first (above).
2. `internal/slicercli/write.go`: `RelayRowAdd`, `RelayRowSet`, `RelayRowRemove`, `RelayRowMove`, `RelayRuleEdit` over `c.write` with a nil-sink writer. Pass flags only when given.
3. `internal/daemon/matrix.go`: method `matrix.edit` (*proposed*) `{project, op, id, fields}` for the five ops; resolve the project with `d.registered`; return slicer's error as is.
4. `internal/tui`: edit keys on the S168 view (default: `e` edit row, `n` new row, `d` remove, `m` move, `r` rule text); a form per op; confirm; reload the matrix after success.
5. Docs: `dashboard.md` (matrix editor), `boundaries.md` (ork calls the edit commands, slicer still owns the file), `CHANGELOG.md`. Goldens: `go test ./internal/tui -update`.
Open: (1) Surface: TUI editor only (default), or also `ork roles matrix set|add|remove|move|rule-edit` for scripts. (2) Verbs: the five the gap names (default), or also `rule-add` and `rule-remove`. (3) Free text for agent, vendor and model (default, with the skip warning), or a pick list of the two agents ork runs. (4) Leave the edit uncommitted (default), or ork commits `.slicer` as `Edit relay roles` (a git write the owner has not allowed).
